<b>Pilgrim Preacher</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are one of the few hardy pilgrims to have reached [[the Citadel]], found resting in [[Songclave]].

== In-game Events ==
Pilgrim Preacher can be found in Songclave during [[Act 2]] in the place where [[Scared Pilgrim]] previously could be seen resting, if the latter has left and [[Lace]] is defeated in [[the Cradle]]. They warn Hornet of the "haunted husks" elsewhere in the Citadel and ask her not to go too far.

After their dialogue has been exhausted, they have a 25% chance of being gone the next time Hornet reenters Songclave after resting elsewhere. Once they have left, they remain absent for the rest of the game.

== Location ==
Pilgrim Preacher can be found near the [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] in Songclave in Act 2 if Scared Pilgrim has left and Lace is defeated in the Cradle.
